articles.title: AscentOptics Achieves Volume Delivery of 400G and 800G Optical Modules to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Development
articles.mainIdea: AscentOptics Achieves Volume Delivery of 400G and 800G Optical Modules to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Development
articles.summary: TMX Newsfile: AscentOptics Achieves Volume Delivery of 400G and 800G Optical Modules to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Development. AscentOptics begins mass delivery of 400G and 800G optical modules, supporting global CSPs and AI infrastructure with high-bandwidth connectivity.Shenzhen, China--(Newsfile Corp. - January 26, 2026) - AscentOptics, a leading provider of optical transceiver solutions, today announced that its 400G and 800G AI optical modules have entered volume production and are being delivered to cloud service providers across multiple regions, supporting AI and cloud infrastructure deployments. This milestone.
